note: Reversion Triad signal tier plus outside-click race fix. Outside-click listener now uses 50ms grace so the click that opens the menu cannot bubble up and close it on the same tick. Reversion Triad fires gold-star markers when EXHAUSTION (tpSpread beyond plus or minus 1.2 ATR) plus CONFLUENCE (3 of 5 components agree: EMA aligned, RSI past 50, MACD past signal, tempROC trending, price relative to gravity) plus PULLBACK-TO-GRAVITY (price touched gravity in the last 5 bars and is now turning the other way) all coincide. Selective by design. Sits on top of the existing triad triangles, not replacing them. backtestSignals tracks the reversion series separately so we can measure whether selectivity actually pays off.
